title: Facet-dependent hematite reactivity in Cr(VI) removal with Fe(II)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1305-1315
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00733F, Paper
Shengnan Zhang, Lingyi Li, Junxue Li, Wei Cheng
This study investigates the facet-dependent reactivity of hematite nanocrystals in conjunction with Fe(II) for the removal of Cr(VI) from aqueous solutions.
